title: Evaluation sheet: smiley faces
subject: Art & Design
unit: Summer 2: Sky painting and food (Splendid Skies and Chop, Slice & Mash)
source: Written for art/y1 lesson 12 (Evaluation sheet: smiley faces (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 12: Chop, slice and mash: a fruit salad or dip. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

parts.text: Cut down slowly between your fingers
Put the slices in the bowl

panels.title: Mash it
points: Mash a banana or avocado for a dip

keywords.def: keeping clean so germs do not spread
squash food until it is soft
say what went well and what to change

questions.q: Which hold keeps fingers tucked in?
Which tool do we mash with?
Core: With an adult, make a fruit salad or a mashed dip using two of chop, slice and mash.
questions.a: A fruit salad or dip made with clean hands and safe cutting

questions.q: Extend: Say one thing that went well.
questions.a: For example: I sliced the banana safely

questions.q: Stretch: Say one thing you would change next time and why.
questions.a: For example: add an orange to make it juicier
A) Wash our hands. Clean hands stop germs getting on food.

questions.q: Big question: what makes your fruit salad safe and clean?
questions.a: Clean hands, washed fruit, a clean board and safe cutting with an adult
